title: Uruguayan-Style German Flank Steak
description: A hearty, German-inspired dish featuring a tender Uruguayan-style flank steak, marinated in a rich and savory sauce. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Season the flank steak with Uruguayan steak seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the steak for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
Transfer the steak to a baking dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, cook the onion and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the beef broth, red wine, and stew to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until slightly thickened.
Return the steak to the skillet and spoon some of the sauce over the top.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the steak reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the steak rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
